name: A Link Between Twilight Plugin
author: Dusklight WW crew (fork-local, never shipped)
description: The Wind Waker layer, mod-side. Serves byte-identical donor files straight from the user's own Wind Waker (USA) disc image — nothing staged, nothing shipped, zero-bake carried to completion — and registers WW actors above the host's proc enum via by-name hooks, with no receiver edit, on a stock dusklight. Configure mod.wwDonorDisc.wwIsoPath with the path to a plain GZLE01 .iso.
